name: andrewferk
description: Andrew Ferk's Claude Code plugins: guardrails and review loops for agentic TDD.

plugins.name: comment-guard
plugins.description: Keeps LLM-written code free of restating, narrating, and document-citing comments. Delivers the policy by hook, tightens it for mattpocock skills, blocks edits that break it, re-checks the branch before the agent stops, and runs as a GitHub Action on pull requests.

plugins.name: adversarial-code-review
plugins.description: Adversarial cross-model code review: a reviewer on a different model challenges your draft PR through the Cursor CLI, argues back in comments, and marks it ready only once both agree.
